ثَمَلٌ Remanence, stay, residence, or tarriance; like ↓ ثَمْلٌ : (T, M, K:) [the latter is an inf. n.: see 1:] and both signify also ease; repose; easiness of life, and ampleness of the circumstances thereof. (T.) You say دَارُ ثَمَلٍ (T, M) and ↓ ثَمْلٍ (M) An abode of [fixed] residence, (T, M,) and of ease, or repose, &c. (T.) And ↓ مَكَانُ ثَمْلٍ A place peopled, inhabited, well stocked with people and the like. (Th, AAF, M.) And دَارُ بَنِى فُلَانٍ ثَمَلٌ and ↓ ثَمْلٌ The abode of the sons of such a one is an abode of [fixed] residence. (IDrd, TA.) ―
-b2- Shade, or shadow. (M, K.) ＝
-A2- Intoxication: (K:) inf. n. of ثَمِلَ. (S, M.) ＝
-A3- See also ثَمَلَةٌ, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
